definitions.explanation: A verbal warning or reprimand intended to correct behavior or prevent mistakes.
A guiding principle or moral drawn from experience, often passed down as wisdom.

⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{戒|いまし}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。

notes:
The noun form of the verb {戒|いまし}める (to warn, to admonish). Refers both to a warning given to correct someone and to a moral lesson or precept.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戒|いまし}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a warning
- {戒|いまし}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to heed a warning
- {戒|いまし}め⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take as a lesson
- {戒|いまし}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: words of admonition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{警告|けいこく}→警告：02696_keikoku⟧: official or formal warning, often about danger
- ⟦{忠告|ちゅうこく}→忠告：05462_chuukoku⟧: advice or counsel given out of concern
- ⟦{教訓|きょうくん}→教訓：12721_kyoukun⟧: moral lesson, often drawn from stories or experience

{戒|いまし}め has a more personal, moral tone compared to the more formal ⟦{警告|けいこく}→警告：02696_keikoku⟧, and overlaps with ⟦{教訓|きょうくん}→教訓：12721_kyoukun⟧ in the sense of a lesson learned.
